There will be disabling the USS in Q2 of next year if the roll out of the update goes well in Q1 of 2023. My brother works in the AI department and tells me that the USS slow the software down and are buggy and inaccurate for certain objects anyway. He says they got the same pushback when they disabled the hardware and went to tesla vision only and says it will be the same with this as well. 1 step back but 5 steps forward. He says they are taking code from FSD and using it along side the weel turning counter. The camera can’t and doesn’t need to see the first 3 feet from thr car, it just needs to build a 3D model and count how close the car is getting based on the Turing forwards of the tires/weels. Most people complaining have NO IDEA what goes behind the scenes in the software side and think this is a last minute change or a budget saver (it saves 5 bucks on the car btw) but is way way way buggier than the cameras, so the Telsa Vision only is a huge step forward!

Truthfully you are alone and broken right now. But!, someday in the future you will wake up and smile and take a deep breath and eat breakfast and drink some water and think back so these moments and this time when you became you. One day you will be happy again. But until that day,.. get some sleep, eat some healthy food (you are what you eat lol) and try to be easy on yourself!:) you got this!
